title: Asian Group – XK45MT-3B CNC Router Modernization

date.notes: Supplied photos include November 2025 and May 2026 dates, and a related technical invoice is dated 21/06/2026. Exact project start/end dates were not separately confirmed by the owner.

summary: Modernization and restoration of an approximately 25-year-old XK45MT-3B three-spindle CNC router at Asian Group of Companies, Kohilawatta. The original NCStudio-based control platform was converted to Mach3, with control-panel redesign and rewiring, motion-control and parallel-interface integration, Mach3 configuration, three-spindle/VFD setup, electrical and pneumatic repairs, machine calibration, testing and recommissioning. The completed machine was handed over in working condition.
problem: An aging CNC router required control-system modernization and restoration, including replacement of the original NCStudio-based control approach with a maintainable Mach3-based control solution and repair/configuration of related spindle, VFD, electrical and pneumatic systems.
scope: Parallel/control-interface board repair, modification and integration
Three VFD setup, service, repair or replacement as required
Three spindle motor service and repair
outcome: The NCStudio-based machine was converted to Mach3, calibrated, tested and handed over in working condition, as confirmed by the owner.
evo_role: CNC control-system modernization, panel redesign/rewiring, motion-control integration, VFD and spindle work, electrical/pneumatic repair, calibration and recommissioning.
